admission.justification: Realized across PaseoChatFrame.tsx, paseoFrameControl.ts, and paseoFrameModel.ts and guarded by component timer tests; prevents first-visit bootstrap double-loads from entering a destructive 20 s reload loop and prevents stale timeout notices from stranding late-ready frames.

applicability: Embedded chat iframe startup and reload readiness timing across Chats, Operations document chat, and Review explainer frames.
conditions: PASEO_CONTROL_TIMEOUT_MS stays 10_000 ms and is armed or reset only on iframe onLoad while a load is in flight.
PASEO_COLD_LOAD_CAP_MS bounds missing onLoad to 45_000 ms from load() and settles control to unavailable without reloading the in-flight iframe.
onReady clears stale timeout or unavailable agentProblem text and re-attempts an unshown wanted target while keeping explicit non-open-agent URL steering.
exclusions: Unanswered open-request pings after readiness remain on probe()'s single URL-fallback path.
Explicit Retry while control is unavailable still triggers a new frame generation.
Backend explainer state publication is outside this frontend contract.

evidence: npx --prefix dashboard vitest run src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.retry.test.tsx; report 261112-BUG-L62-worker-9e7b04bc-afc8-55ae-afa7-c9e1e9ca0088.md

statement: Embedded chat readiness timing anchors its 10 s post-load window and ping to iframe onLoad events (resetting across bootstrap double-loads), bounds missing onLoad under a 45 s cold-load cap that settles to unavailable without destroying or reloading the in-flight iframe, keeps receiving late ready or pong messages, and clears stale timeout problem notices while re-attempting unshown wanted targets on ready.
title: Iframe onLoad anchors readiness and 45 s cold cap settles without reload
